description: This Java class defines configuration properties for Hono's credentials API, specifically for file-based credential storage and bcrypt iteration settings. It extends a base configuration class and allows getting and setting the maximum bcrypt iterations with validation.

classes.name: FileBasedCredentialsConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration class for managing credentials storage settings, including the filename and bcrypt iterations.

methods.name: getMaxBcryptIterations
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bcrypt iterations used for password hashing.

methods.name: setMaxBcryptIterations
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bcrypt iterations, with validation to ensure the value is between 4 and 31.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the default filename for credentials storage.
